answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
